model_type: frozen baseline int16 TFLite plus a learned sparse one-hot residual-cell neural adapter
split_method: randomly shuffled rows independently within each source file into 70/15/15 train/validation/test
inference_composition: encode the sensor/PGA tuple into the trained cell one-hot vector; run this int16 correction model; clip correction in mV, divide by 1000, and add to V4 output index 4 of the original baseline int16 TFLite model
test_selection_note: Random-row test split intentionally shares acquisition runs with training, per requested shuffled split. It estimates within-dataset interpolation, not transfer to an unseen acquisition block or capture session.
